bus.via: Rạp Xiếc Trung Ương to Ninh Bình

trips.route_note: Take a train or express bus south from Hanoi to Ninh Binh, then a short taxi or bicycle ride to the Tam Coc and Trang An boat docks.
see: Tam Coc boat ride through limestone karsts
trips.tour_query: Ninh Binh day trip from Hanoi
trips.why: The express bus is fastest at 1h 11m and drops you near the Tam Coc and Trang An boat docks.
know: Book the Trang An or Tam Coc boat ride in advance, especially on weekends
Best in the dry season from around November to April
Bring sun protection; boats are open-air

trips.route_note: Express limousine buses run directly from Hanoi to Ha Long in about 2.5-3 hours; day cruises depart from the Tuan Chau or Bai Chay piers.
trips.tour_query: Ha Long Bay day cruise from Hanoi
trips.why: The listed bus takes 4h 30m each way, so a day trip needs an organized cruise tour to work.
know: Day cruises depart from Tuan Chau or Bai Chay piers
Book ahead to secure a cruise slot
Check weather; cruises can be cancelled in storms

bus.via: Ha Noi Nuoc Ngam Bus Station to Hai Phong Niem Nghia Bus Station

trips.route_note: Frequent trains and express buses connect Hanoi with Hai Phong in roughly 2-2.5 hours; from the city a local bus or taxi reaches Cat Ba ferry piers.
see: French colonial architecture in the city centre
Cat Ba Island and Lan Ha Bay
trips.tour_query: Hai Phong and Cat Ba day trip from Hanoi
trips.why: The express bus is fastest at 1h 30m and frequent, with trains as a backup.
know: Cat Ba ferry piers are reached by local bus or taxi from the city
Best in the dry season from around November to April
